value.rationale: The invariant is the natural exact two-primitive-orbit conductor of an entire canonical three-consecutive-return-length SFT family. It detects multiplicity rather than merely periodic orbit existence and exhibits a non-obvious even/odd quadratic dichotomy and isolated smallest case. A sharp endpoint and complete eventual multiplicity classification have direct use in selecting periods with multiple independent periodic measures, without claiming a broader mixing or entropy theorem.
